UserSettings.title: Settings
UserSettings.description: Tune the sidebar's basic preferences. Changes apply immediately.
UserSettings.themeColorsDescription: Pick a base and primary color. Fonts, radius, and shadows live on the theme page.

ThemePage.title: Styles
ThemePage.description: Tune colors, radius, shadows, and typography across the product. Every choice writes to the global theme and updates the live preview.
ThemePage.baseColorDescription: Controls backgrounds, cards, borders, and neutral shades.
ThemePage.primaryColorDescription: Used for primary buttons, charts, and emphasis.
ThemePage.radiusDescription: Unifies component corners. The preview updates instantly.
ThemePage.shadowDescription: Adjust shadow depth for cards, popovers, and buttons.
ThemePage.typographyDescription: Body merges Latin and Chinese fonts; heading and mono remain independent.
ThemePage.bodyFontHint: Chinese and Latin share one body setting
ThemePage.previewBody: Adjust colors, radius, shadows, and type to see this preview react.

users.title: Users
users.description: Manage local users, activation state, and role assignments.
users.formDescription: Profile data lives locally; credentials are managed by Logto.
users.rolesHint: Roles determine which permissions the user has.
users.emailHint: The user must sign in through Logto with the same email before this local account is linked.
users.emailLocked: Email comes from Logto and cannot be changed here.
users.selfHint: You cannot change your own activation state or roles, so you cannot lock yourself out.
users.deleteDescription: Delete {email}? Their sessions and role assignments will be removed permanently.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Group permissions into roles, then assign roles to users.
roles.formDescription: A role is a set of permissions; built-in roles are maintained by the seed.
roles.permissionsHint: Select the permissions this role grants.
roles.systemHint: Built-in roles are maintained by the seed and cannot be changed here.
roles.inUse: This role is still assigned to users and cannot be deleted.
roles.deleteDescription: Delete the role {name}? It will be removed from every user permanently.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: Maintain permission identifiers that roles can grant.
permissions.formDescription: Use the module:action format so permissions group cleanly.
permissions.nameHint: Use the module:action format, for example post:publish.
permissions.moduleHint: Leave blank to use the part before the colon.
permissions.builtinHint: Built-in permissions are maintained by the seed; only the description can be edited.
permissions.deleteDescription: Delete the permission {name}? Roles referencing it will lose it immediately.

errors.email_taken: That email is already in use.
errors.invalid_name: Name cannot be empty or longer than 80 characters.
errors.invalid_role_name: Role name cannot be empty or longer than 50 characters.
errors.invalid_permission_name: Use the module:action format, for example post:publish.
errors.invalid_permission_module: Module can only contain lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
errors.invalid_description: Description cannot be longer than 300 characters.
errors.self_delete: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with.
errors.self_deactivate: You cannot disable the account you are signed in with.
errors.self_roles: You cannot change your own roles. Ask another administrator.
errors.last_admin: At least one active administrator must remain.
errors.system_role: Built-in roles cannot be changed or deleted.
errors.system_permission: Built-in permissions cannot be renamed or deleted.
errors.role_in_use: This role is still assigned to users. Remove those assignments first.
errors.not_found: The record does not exist or was already deleted.
errors.unauthorized: Your session expired. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to perform this action.
errors.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.

providers.title: Providers
providers.description: Configure model providers and credentials. Users only see active models.
providers.formDescription: The API key is encrypted. Leave it blank while editing to keep the current key.
providers.baseUrlHint: Leave blank for the provider default. For OpenAI-compatible services include /v1.
providers.apiKeyKeep: Leave blank to keep current key
providers.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? All of its models will be removed. Existing conversations keep their content.

models.title: Models
models.description: Manage models users can select. Disabled models disappear from chat.
models.formDescription: The model ID is defined by the provider. Context window and max output trim history and cap generation.
models.modelIdHint: The provider-facing model name, for example gpt-4.1-mini.
models.embeddingDimensionHint: Must match the Qdrant collection; the current single collection is fixed at 1024.
models.testFailed: Model call failed. Check the key, base URL, and model ID.
models.needProvider: Create a provider before adding models.
models.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? Conversations using it must select another model.

agents.title: Agents
agents.description: Combine a model with a system prompt. Chat users pick an agent instead of a model.
agents.formDescription: An agent decides which model to use and what system prompt to send. Changes apply to the next message.
agents.descriptionPlaceholder: One line about what this agent is for
agents.systemPromptPlaceholder: For example: You are a senior code reviewer...
agents.systemPromptHint: The system prompt is sent with the highest priority on every turn.
agents.ragPlaceholder: RAG linking is not available yet. This agent will not search any knowledge base.
agents.knowledgeBasesHint: Selected libraries are searched before each reply and the results are added to the prompt.
agents.noLibraries: No RAG libraries yet. Create one on the RAG page first.
agents.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? Conversations using it will ask users to pick another agent.
agents.needModel: Create a model before adding agents.

Rag.title: RAG libraries
Rag.description: Manage vector knowledge bases and vectorize files from My files for agents to retrieve.
Rag.formDescription: A library is bound to one embedding model. Once vectors exist the model cannot change.
Rag.empty: No libraries yet. Create one first.
Rag.deleteDescription: Delete {name}? File references, chunks, and Qdrant vectors are removed. Original files stay in My files.
Rag.name: Name
Rag.missingConfig: Qdrant is not configured. Set QDRANT_URL, QDRANT_COLLECTION, and QDRANT_VECTOR_SIZE first.

Rag.modelLockedHint: This library already has vectors and its model cannot change. Delete and recreate it to switch.
Rag.emptyFiles: No files yet. Use Add files to pick from My files.
Rag.removeDescription: Remove {name} from the library? Chunks and vectors are deleted; the original file stays in My files.
